Repair tile logic for signing, ping-pong, shred handling, and slot repair metrics.

# Purpose
The `repair` tile implements the repair service for the network. It receives input from network, gossip, shred, tower, snapshot, stake, genesis, and sign links, then processes repair traffic for missing shreds and related protocol messages. The file defines the tile context, memory layout, link setup, and the main stem callbacks that handle incoming fragments, outgoing packets, and periodic housekeeping. It also sets up the tile entry point `fd_tile_repair` so the runtime can create and run the tile.

The code handles two request paths. For synchronous work, it processes messages such as `PING` and `PONG` and sends packets directly. For asynchronous work, it sends repair requests to sign tiles, tracks pending requests in `fd_signs_map`, and uses `fd_signs_queue` to hold requests until credits are available. The file also manages peer policy state, inflight request tracking, FEC signature tracking, forest state for slot repair progress, and repair metrics.
